annotations.title: Recent SEC filings of a company

description: Returns a company's recent SEC filings, classified (earnings, 8-K items, insider purchases or sales, offerings…), each with its acceptance time, accession number and sec.gov link, plus a 90-day summary of insider purchases and sales. Insider filings show amounts and the filer's role, not the person's name. Filings are dated by acceptance time, not filing date. Use it when the user asks what a company has filed or announced recently.

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.
